title: Rabbi Menachem bar Tanchum

paragraphs: Rabbi Issi reports in his name, as listed in Seder HaDorot. Under Rabbi Issi it cites Terumot 5:5, but our reading is Rabbi Issi in the name of Rabbi Mana bar Tanchum.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Seder HaDorot notice names Menachem bar Tanchum and says that Issi reports in his name. The checked Jerusalem Talmud Terumot passage instead has Issi reporting Rabbi Mana bar Tanchum. It occurs in chapter 5, halakhah 2 in that digital arrangement; Hyman’s printed 5:5 is retained. The two name forms are not silently identified, and the separate Issi entry in Seder HaDorot has not been directly collated.
